title: Owner decision queue record (rizzstack.owner-decision/1)
description: Two durable documents for one decision that only a human may make. A REQUEST is written mechanically by the pipeline when work reaches a point the autonomy architecture reserves for the owner: resolving a gate, spending beyond the authorized budget, widening the file or test scope, or enrolling or revoking a grant. A DECISION is recorded by or for the owner: approve, deny, or defer. The queue validates the pair mechanically and applies a final answer exactly once. Silence is never consent: a request with no decision stays pending and no timeout turns silence into approval. Neither document grants authority; the request restates exactly what is being asked and the decision answers that question and nothing else.
$comment: A request is sealed by request_digest: sha256 over json.dumps(request, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True) without request_digest. A decision binds the exact request bytes through request_digest and echoes the request's decision_nonce, so a decision cannot be replayed against a different request. bundlebees_plugin/decision_queue.py implements the queue, the digests and the mechanical validation.

id.description: Opaque identifier. Not a URL, path, hostname, or credential.

nonce.description: Random value generated when the request is sealed. The decision must echo it unchanged.

owner_kind.description: gate: resolve a named gate. budget: allow spend beyond the authorized amount. scope: widen the file or test scope. grant: enroll or revoke a grant. The vocabulary is closed in v1: a mechanical queue applies only decisions it recognizes.

grant_action.description: What the grant request asks the owner to decide.

outcome.description: approve and deny are final answers the queue applies. defer records that the owner saw the question and is not deciding yet; the request stays pending and a later decision is still possible.

kind.description: record: a durable state file such as a job document or the approval envelope that authorizes the work. report: a generated report such as a job report or campaign report. metric: an aggregated observability figure.

reference.description: Durable reference to the evidence. A reference is not a copy: the record it names stays authoritative.

sha256.description: Optional content hash of the referenced record, when the producer recorded one.

rel_path.description: Repository-relative path. Never absolute, never an external location.

schema.description: Protocol version. Shape only: the queue refuses any version outside rizzstack.owner-decision/1.

record.description: Discriminates the two documents of one queue entry.

request_id.description: Stable identity of this request. It names the queue record on disk and appears in the snapshot decisions section.

subject.description: What the decision governs: a gate name, a job or feature id, or a grant id. Opaque; never a path or a URL.

question.description: The question the owner answers, stated before the owner sees it, so the decision stays bounded to it.

evidence.description: At least one durable reference the owner can inspect. A request with no evidence is a claim, not a decision request.

spend_ceiling_usd.description: Budget kind only: the spend ceiling the request proposes to raise, in US dollars. Refused on every other kind.

requested_addition_usd.description: Budget kind only: how much spend beyond the currently approved budget the request asks for. Refused on every other kind.

proposed_paths.description: Scope kind only: the paths the request proposes to add to the authorized scope. Refused on every other kind.

grant_id.description: Grant kind only: the grant the request asks to enroll or revoke. Refused on every other kind.

grant_action.description: Grant kind only. Refused on every other kind.

raised_by.description: The mechanical component that raised the request. Agents never raise owner decisions; they may only reason inside a recovery request.

decision_nonce.description: Sealed into the request and echoed by the decision, so a decision cannot be replayed against a different request even by copy error.

request_digest.description: sha256 over the canonical request without request_digest. The queue recomputes it on every read and refuses a mismatch.

schema.description: Protocol version. Shape only: the queue refuses any version outside rizzstack.owner-decision/1.

record.description: Discriminates the two documents of one queue entry.

request_digest.description: The binding: it must equal the named request's request_digest and a recomputation from that request's body.

decision_nonce.description: Must equal the named request's decision_nonce.

decided_by.description: Who recorded the answer. The record preserves it; the approval receipt reference is the proof of the owner's act.

approval_receipt_ref.description: Durable reference to the receipt that proves the owner's act, for example the approval file in the plugin state. Required and non-null when the outcome is approve; the queue refuses an approval without one. Must be null for deny and defer.

rationale.description: Why this outcome answers the question. Scrubbed: never a prompt, transcript, or credential material.

decision_digest.description: sha256 over the canonical decision without decision_digest. The queue recomputes it on every read and refuses a mismatch.
